data.name: Donald
data.gender_notes: Donald is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Scottish name 'Donald' and Old English name 'Dunald', meaning 'Ruler of the Valley' or 'Ruler of the World'. In Scotland, it was traditionally given to the heir to the throne. The name Donald carries the meaning “Ruler of the World” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Donald usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and leadership in spiritual matters.
data.etymology: Donald belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Donald total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: דונאלד
in_hebrew.meaning: חזק וגדול, דונאלד הוא שם שמשמעותו גדול ו חזק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דונאלד הוא שם שמקורו בשם הסקוטי דונאלד, שמשמעותו 'חזק וגדול' או 'גדול ו חזק'. השם דונאלד מורכב משני מילים: 'דון' שמשמעותו 'עולם' או 'חוזק' ו-'אלד' שמשמעותו 'גדול' או 'חזק'. השם דונאלד היה נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים והיה קשור לחוזק וגדלות הנפש.

in_greek.name: Ντόναλντ
in_greek.meaning: Το Ντόναλντ σημαίνει ισχυρός και μεγάλος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Ντόναλντ είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από το σκωτσέζικο όνομα Donald, που σημαίνει 'ισχυρός και μεγάλος' ή 'μεγάλος και ισχυρός'. Το όνομα Donald αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'don' που σημαίνει 'κόσμος' ή 'δύναμη' και 'ald' που σημαίνει 'μεγάλος' ή 'ισχυρός'. Το όνομα Ντόναλντ ήταν συνηθισμένο ανάμεσα στους Χριστιανούς και συνδέονταν με τη δύναμη και τη μεγαλοσύνη του πνεύματος.

in_latin.name: Donaldus
in_latin.long_meaning: Donaldus nomen est quod ex scotico nomine Donald originem ducit, quod significat 'robustsus et magnus' aut 'magnus et robustus'. Nomen Donaldus ex duobus vocabulis constat: 'don' quod significat 'mundus' aut 'fortitudo' et 'ald' quod significat 'magnus' aut 'robustsus'. Nomen Donaldus apud Christianos usitatum erat et cum fortitudine et magnitudine animi coniunctum erat.

in_english.name: Donald
in_english.meaning: Donald means strong and powerful leader
in_english.long_meaning: The name Donald originates from the Scottish Gaelic name Domhnall, which means 'strong and powerful leader' or 'world ruler'. It is derived from the Old Celtic words 'dom' meaning 'world' and 'vall' meaning 'rule' or 'power'. The name Donald has been popularized by several Scottish and Irish kings and saints, including Saint Donald, a 7th-century Irish saint. In Christian tradition, the name Donald symbolizes strength, leadership, and devotion to God.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Donald has spiritual significance, as it derives from the Old Norse belief in the power and protection of the mountains and valleys. Put simply, the name Donald represents the Christian ideal of a compassionate leader, who rules with wisdom and strength, providing security and guidance to those they serve.

Donald, as a Christian name, encourages the bearer to strive for Godly wisdom, strength, and leadership in their daily lives.
